scope: Every open issue in the organization at the start of this audit pass; historical closed issues are not reopened or re-certified.

issues.finding: Battle Smith has executable Eberron grants and Steel Defender flows; exact Tasha-source acceptance and complete ordering/rebuild evidence remain unverified.
issues.title: Verify exact-source Battle Smith grants and subclass-order parity
issues.next_step: Run both subclass-selection/leveling orders with the exact Tasha Pack and compare complete cards, Defender lifecycle, replay and restart receipts.

issues.finding: Generic consumables and selected official item effects exist; there is no complete source-bound mundane gear action catalog covering the listed items.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 adventuring gear settlement
issues.next_step: Implement a reviewed item-by-item action matrix; retain source-bound quantities, timing and unresolved environmental choices.

issues.finding: Sunlight Sensitivity is descriptive content and synthetic test input; no production trait consumer derives attack/sight-check disadvantage from scene sunlight.
issues.title: Enforce 2014 Sunlight Sensitivity on attacks and sight checks
issues.next_step: Bind direct-sunlight and sight-use facts to attacks and Perception before RNG; cover cancellation and fact expiry.

issues.finding: Group checks and combat Help are separate existing features; no noncombat helper/leader/task eligibility and productive-collaboration transaction exists.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 working-together checks
issues.next_step: Add one helper/leader/task transaction with source eligibility and productive-collaboration facts.

issues.finding: Derived passive Perception and chase/hide consumers exist; a generic ability/skill passive resolver with net +/-5, secret output and a shared modifier path does not.
issues.title: Implement generic source-correct 2014 passive checks
issues.next_step: Introduce a shared passive-check resolver and reconcile existing Perception/chase consumers without secret leakage.

issues.finding: Campaign time exists; source-bound 8-hour activity days, crafting costs/proficiency, profession, recuperation, research and training settlement are absent.
issues.title: Implement 2014 lifestyle and downtime activity settlement
issues.next_step: Implement activity-day accounting and each source-defined cost/proficiency/result transition.

issues.finding: No short/long/indefinite madness table executor, source-owned effect lifecycle, suppression or cure procedure was found; Crown of Madness vocabulary is unrelated.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 madness effects and cures
issues.next_step: Implement source table rolls, durations, effect provenance, suppression and cure tiers.

issues.finding: Generic scene hazards/source attacks are not a persisted trap model with detection, disarm, trigger, one-shot and complex-initiative lifecycle.
issues.title: Implement source-bound 2014 trap detection, disabling, and settlement
issues.next_step: Persist trap detection/disable/trigger/lifecycle state and integrate existing spatial, damage and initiative paths.

issues.finding: Typed poison damage/conditions exist, but doses/coatings, four delivery gates, named poison counters, midnight and protected-damage lifecycle do not.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 poison delivery and lifecycles
issues.next_step: Add source-owned doses, delivery eligibility, named poison timers/counters and cleanup.

issues.finding: Generic effects/rests do not implement Cackle Fever, Sewer Plague or Sight Rot incubation, recurring saves, transmission, rest restrictions and exact cures.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 disease lifecycles
issues.next_step: Add source-defined disease onset, recurring saves, transmission, restrictions and cures.

issues.finding: Object input still excludes damage_threshold, takes immunities from request data and validates a source citation without binding the supplied numerical object model.
issues.title: Fix 2014 scene-object attack and damage-threshold settlement
issues.next_step: Derive object statistics from a validated source model and apply damage thresholds atomically.

issues.finding: The clock advances time but has no party travel distance/pace ledger, passive-perception pace modifiers or hourly forced-march settlement.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 travel pace and forced-march settlement
issues.next_step: Add travel distance/pace bookkeeping and hourly forced-march saves using the campaign clock.

issues.finding: can_see handles blinded/hidden/invisible and explicit visibility lists; it does not derive illumination, obscuration, darkvision/blindsight/truesight range.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 vision, obscuration, and light settlement
issues.next_step: Derive visibility from authoritative light, obscuration and sense ranges before attack/check settlement.

issues.finding: Long rests use food_and_drink for exhaustion recovery; daily ration/water debt, hot-weather intake, source-owned deprivation and day-boundary saves are absent.
issues.title: Implement 2014 food, water, and starvation exhaustion lifecycle
issues.next_step: Track daily food/water intake and debt and settle deprivation at authoritative time boundaries.

issues.finding: Movement charges path/travel/crawl costs but has no bound run-up and Strength-derived long/high jump declaration or landing-check procedure.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 long-jump and high-jump settlement
issues.next_step: Bind jump type, run-up, distance, movement spend and landing checks to the selected source.

issues.finding: Willingly occupied destinations already fail; hostile traversal by size, occupied-path terrain cost and squeezing state/attack/save modifiers remain absent.
issues.title: Enforce 2014 occupied-space and squeezing movement rules
issues.next_step: Extend path occupancy and squeezing settlement while retaining the already-working occupied-endpoint rejection.

issues.finding: Swim movement speed exists; submerged attack exceptions, beyond-normal-range automatic miss and fully immersed fire resistance are not integrated.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 underwater combat settlement
issues.next_step: Integrate underwater weapon/range exceptions and immersion-based fire resistance into attack/damage settlement.

issues.finding: Dependent-actor support is not a rider/mount contract; mounting cost, controlled/independent turns and forced dismount saves remain absent.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 mounted combat lifecycle
issues.next_step: Add rider/mount relations, turn ownership, movement costs and dismount lifecycle.

issues.finding: Release still accepts a new declaration, changes the holding effect/reaction and returns ready_release_effect pending_ruling instead of executing the stored spell.
issues.title: Execute the predeclared 2014 readied spell on release
issues.next_step: Persist the readied spell response and execute that exact response on release with atomic resource timing.

issues.finding: Release still logs/returns caller declaration and spends reaction without executing the original stored action response.
issues.title: Bind Ready release to and execute the predeclared response
issues.next_step: Persist and execute the original Ready response; reject caller replacement declarations.

issues.finding: advance_single_class_level still enforces one existing class and equal total/class level; adding a second class and combined spell-slot settlement is not supported.
issues.title: Implement source-correct 2014 multiclass advancement
issues.next_step: Support a second class with source prerequisites, combined slots and choice/rebuild parity.

issues.finding: No source-bound settlement was found for Reliable Talent, Blindsense, Slippery Mind, Elusive or Stroke of Luck; resource/display text cannot satisfy those mechanics.
issues.title: Implement remaining high-level 2014 Rogue mechanics
issues.next_step: Implement the five named high-level Rogue mechanics with source-owned choices and resources.

issues.finding: Structured attack target binding and task Help consumption now exist and pass tests. A NEW empty Help payload still creates unbound legacy Help; reproduced in the audit probes.
issues.title: Close the unbound legacy-input gap in 2014 Help
issues.next_step: Reject newly submitted untyped Help or require explicit target/task binding; isolate persisted legacy migration from new declarations.

issues.finding: consume_spell_cast still emits ordinary V/S/M as ruling_required after settlement; authoritative speech/free-hand/focus eligibility is not a complete pre-spend gate.
issues.title: Enforce 2014 spell components before casting
issues.next_step: Resolve ordinary V/S/M eligibility before slots, actions, RNG or state mutate.

issues.finding: Paladin source content exists but there is no source-bound post-hit Divine Smite choice, slot spend and radiant damage settlement.
issues.title: Implement 2014 Paladin Divine Smite settlement
issues.next_step: Add the optional post-hit, pre-damage Divine Smite choice and atomic slot/damage settlement.

issues.finding: Bard use pools and die scaling exist; grant/range/hearing, ten-minute recipient state and post-d20/pre-outcome spend windows are absent.
issues.title: Implement actual 2014 Bardic Inspiration settlement
issues.next_step: Persist the recipient benefit and enforce granting eligibility, duration and post-d20 spending.

issues.finding: Rage still needs an executor. Correct the issue: heavy armor gates the listed benefits, not activation itself; honor the 15th-level Persistent Rage exception to early ending.
issues.title: Implement actual 2014 Barbarian Rage settlement
issues.next_step: Implement Rage from the corrected source requirements, including benefit gating and Persistent Rage.

issues.finding: Weapon IDs/reach are recorded, but max(reach) selects the outermost crossed boundary. Probe: whole path first offers long; split path first offers short/unarmed. Full path equivalence is not fixed.
issues.title: Bind opportunity-attack triggers to weapon reach
issues.next_step: Produce ordered per-weapon reach crossings and prove full-route/segmented-route equivalence.

issues.finding: Voluntary/aggressive movement remains current-turn-only; forced/teleport movement bypasses opportunity attacks. Off-turn self-powered action/reaction movement has no independent payment contract.
issues.title: Model off-turn self-powered movement for opportunity attacks
issues.next_step: Model self-powered off-turn movement with its own action/reaction payment and opportunity-attack eligibility.

issues.finding: Movement assigns the final destination before adding reaction windows. Probe records x=3 while its unresolved reaction boundary is x=2; no resumable movement continuation exists.
issues.title: Pause movement before resolving opportunity attacks
issues.next_step: Pause at the first reaction boundary and persist a resumable movement continuation.

issues.finding: Dueling and Two-Weapon Fighting integration exist; remaining Archery, Defense, Great Weapon Fighting and Protection effects are not fully implemented. The old claim that all but Dueling do nothing is stale.
issues.title: Execute all selected 2014 Fighting Styles
issues.next_step: Implement Archery, Defense, Great Weapon Fighting and Protection; retain Dueling and Two-Weapon Fighting regression coverage.

issues.finding: Legendary Resistance text survives import, but no reviewed use resource and failed-save choice window integrated across save paths was found.
issues.title: Implement 2014 Legendary Resistance settlement
issues.next_step: Create a failed-save Legendary Resistance choice bound to a reviewed resource pool across save paths.

issues.finding: Grappled/Restrained conditions and generic escape exist; source-owned 2014 grapple/shove attack replacements, contests, release and dragging transitions do not.
issues.title: Implement 2014 grapple and shove attack replacements
issues.next_step: Add 2014 grapple/shove attack replacements, source-owned conditions, escape/release and dragging.

issues.finding: All three GitHub advisories still return first_patched_version=null and affected ranges through 1.5.9. Default text-only local installs do not establish that optional Chroma server deployments are fixed.
issues.title: Track unfixed ChromaDB authorization and code-injection advisories
issues.next_step: Keep optional server exposure documented; only upgrade/close after patched versions or an effective verified mitigation cover all three advisories.

issues.finding: Ordered upstream integration remains a selective roadmap with unchecked batches. Local DND work does not satisfy every provider/channel/plugin/TUI requirement.
issues.source: Issue body and main history; preserve licensing and upstream commit attribution.
issues.title: Track ordered NanoBot updates after the July ancestry bridge
issues.next_step: Continue the selective upstream batches only when compatible with current ownership, licensing and product scope.

issues.finding: Metadata-only publishing and freshness check now exist, but the live marker is 2026-09-09 while main index is 2026-09-10. The CLI freshness check fails for that exact mismatch.
issues.title: Refresh public catalog metadata from the current source index
issues.next_step: Publish permitted metadata matching the current catalog and require the freshness check to pass.

issues.finding: Current main normalizes type/character_type for create/update, rejects conflicts before writes, exposes fields in tools/list and permits NPC conversation. Public-facade regression passed today.
issues.title: Make actor_change input type explicit and output-compatible
issues.next_step: Close as completed with the recorded verification evidence.

issues.finding: Unknown fields and unheaded generated text are rejected before staging/job creation; valid headed text yields indexed evidence. Regression passed today.
issues.title: Reject unindexable generated module starts before persistence
issues.next_step: Close as completed with the recorded verification evidence.

issues.finding: Current main normalizes dotted IDs and keeps lineage root identical. Both current ID-shape regressions pass today; merged PR #40 records actual two-Pack/four-ending stdio/replay/restart acceptance.
issues.title: Legacy runtime derivation rejects dotted current Pack IDs
issues.next_step: Close as completed with the recorded verification evidence.

issues.finding: All nine active product/docs repositories now report private vulnerability reporting, secret scanning, push protection and Dependabot security updates enabled; alerts endpoints return 204. Organization and Agent security policies have current ownership/reporting guidance.
issues.title: Enable a working private vulnerability and repository security baseline
issues.next_step: Close as completed with the recorded verification evidence.

issues.finding: All workflow action references and the two nested composite action pins resolve to node24 or node24 composites. Previous post-merge acceptance is recorded on this issue; fresh profile-sync and Pages log checks contain no Node-20 warning.
issues.source: All nine .github/workflows directories; upstream action.yml; issue completion comment
issues.title: Upgrade active GitHub Actions off the deprecated Node 20 runtime
issues.next_step: Close as completed with the recorded verification evidence.
